hero.description: Blue Lagoon 3 is a countryside swim stop farther from central Vang Vieng than the famous first lagoon, useful when the road journey and a slower half-day matter as much as the water.
steps: Check the road before setting out
Go earlier for a calmer swim
Leave time for the ride back
hero.rhythmNote: Numbered lagoons can change facilities, access and activity setups over time. Choose the place for a swim-and-countryside break, then confirm the current details on arrival.

chapters.label: THE CHOICE
chapters.title: Go for the road-and-water combination
chapters.body: Blue Lagoon 3 makes more sense when you want to leave the town behind for several hours. The journey through Vang Vieng's western countryside is part of the value, so do not compare it with Blue Lagoon 1 only by the colour of the water.

chapters.label: THE PACE
chapters.title: A lagoon is a pause, not a checklist item
chapters.body: Give the stop enough time to swim, dry off and sit without immediately starting the return ride. If facilities or water conditions are not appealing that day, the correct move is simply to shorten the stop rather than forcing the plan.

note.label: USEFUL CHOICE
note.text: Blue Lagoon 3 is strongest when you want a half-day escape from town, not the fastest famous stop.

items.label: Time
items.detail: Allow for the road in both directions as well as actual swimming time.

items.label: Road
items.detail: The final countryside approach can change after rain or road works.

items.label: Facilities
items.detail: Confirm current activities and opening arrangements on arrival rather than assuming every online photo still matches.

items.label: Entry
items.detail: Confirm the current entrance fee locally.

faq.question: Is Blue Lagoon 3 the same as Blue Lagoon 1?
faq.answer: No. It is a separate numbered lagoon farther into the countryside west of Vang Vieng.

faq.question: How much time should I allow?
faq.answer: Treat it as a half-day because the road transfer is a meaningful part of the outing.

faq.question: Is it always quieter than Blue Lagoon 1?
faq.answer: Not guaranteed. Crowd levels change by season, day and tour traffic, so go for the setting and slower route rather than a promise of emptiness.

faq.question: Should I check road conditions?
faq.answer: Yes, especially after rain. Local roads and the final approach can change faster than travel articles are updated.
